root_cause: The authenticated Portal Relevantie & verbeteringen page labels healthy status ok as Bewezen. The upstream living-memory projection previously copied raw memory status PROVEN without checking an actual tenant-matched verified outcome/evidence chain.
impact: A source PROVEN claim without immutable provider/outcome readback could reach a customer-facing proved badge.
fix: Downgrade unbacked PROVEN memory to REVIEW_REQUIRED in derived tenant projection only; require verified memory, same-tenant outcome with executed/verified/result/owner and matching real evidence IDs.
prevention_rule: No customer-visible PROVEN from status alone; require verified outcome and evidence lookup in same authenticated tenant. Never fabricate evidence or mutate original records.
